troubleshooting.title: A page says no person is selected
troubleshooting.shortdesc: What to do when Family tree asks you to pick a person first, or Person, Events and Notes show only the search box.

condition.p: You choose and the page says Select a person to view their family tree. Or you choose , or and the page is empty under the search box.

cause.p: These pages show one person at a time. You have not opened anyone since the app started. There is no chip that starts with at the top.

step.cmd: Type a name in the search box at the top, then choose .
Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The chip that starts with shows their name. The page now works.

cause.p: The page is empty because nothing has been added to the tree yet. , and start empty.

step.cmd: Choose and add the first one.
